title: Pyrite
body:
Description

Pyrite can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate, Darkslate, Blueslate, and Limestone.

The raw form of Pyrite takes on a darker yellow color that could be mistaken for Gold, which is much more valuable.

Putting Pyrite in a refinery raises the sell price to $22/stud. Putting that refined Pyrite through a forge further increases the price to $24/stud.

Like every other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Pyrite to complete Schematics.

Trivia

  • Because of its similarity in appearance to Gold, in real life and in game, Pyrite has been titled "Fool's Gold".
  • To remember the difference between Pyrite and Gold, Gold is in a nugget-like shape and Pyrite is cubical.
  • Even if it's refined or forged, Pyrite looks almost exactly like Gold, and the only difference is that Gold is darker in tone than Pyrite.
  • In the real-life gold rush, People often tricked other gold buyers by giving them Pyrite instead of Gold because of the resemblance. With the victim thinking it is real gold and, in the end, getting scammed.
